highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the bundled engine to Skia m151.
highlights_body: It adds .NET 11 WebAssembly support, accelerates color conversion and text shaping, and restores CPU raster performance. SKColor hex parsing now rejects whitespace immediately after `#`; check the breaking change before upgrading.

breaking.title: SKColor hex parsing rejects whitespace after the hash
breaking.body: SKColor.Parse and TryParse no longer accept whitespace immediately after `#` in six- and eight-digit hex colors. Remove that whitespace before parsing.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer from Chrome milestone 150 to milestone 151 without changing the generated C# binding surface.
Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing overloads for SKColor, SKFourByteTag, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag, avoiding substring creation when parsing slices.
Removes the unnecessary unsafe modifier from GRContextOptions for easier use in safe code.
Restores the optimized shader context for scaled and tiled bitmap drawing, addressing high CPU use, frame drops, and flicker.
Includes upstream fixes for stencil clears in native coordinates and preserve mode, plus dirty tracking after a failed resolve task.
Prevents a use-after-free and invalid free while rejecting a corrupt serialized Slug buffer.
Moves SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiplication and unpremultiplication to managed math, removing per-call native transitions.
Reads SKShaper glyph results through zero-copy spans and uses pooled UTF-8 encoding in HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string).
SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) now disposes the full-size intermediate image when a subset returns a different image.
Ships Emscripten 5.0.6 native assets for .NET 11 and builds them with the matching exnref exception model, fixing link and browser startup failures.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: .NET 11 WebAssembly native assets and SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM warning cleanup

v4.151.0-preview.1.1.summary: Opens the 4.151 line with the Skia m151 engine update.

v4.151.0-preview.2.1.summary: Tightens SKColor hex parsing by rejecting whitespace after `#` and adds span-based parsing for SKColor, SKFourByteTag, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag. Speeds SKShaper and HarfBuzz UTF-8 shaping, fixes corrupt Slug cleanup, and removes GRContextOptions' unnecessary unsafe requirement.

v4.151.0-rc.1.1.summary: Adds .NET 11 WebAssembly libraries and compatible exception handling, and restores fast CPU rasterization for scaled and tiled bitmaps. Speeds single-color conversions, fixes intermediate SKImage disposal, and includes Ganesh stencil and resolve fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 adds span-based Tag parsing, removes its scratch-buffer overhead, and uses pooled UTF-8 encoding in Buffer.AddUtf8(string).
